post.description: Auth: `guest_session` cookie. Same lock and 15-min expiry as staff payments, through `PaymentService`. Errors: 409 NOTHING_TO_PAY, PAYMENT_IN_FLIGHT, PROMPTPAY_NOT_SET, PAYMENT_MODE_UNAVAILABLE. `Idempotency-Key` replays the same payment.

patch.description: Permission: menu:write. Access token from the access_token cookie, or Authorization: Bearer. Send the updatedAt you loaded; an older one → 409 MENU_ITEM_STALE with the current item. Variants are the new active set: listed ids are kept, new ones added, missing ones deactivated (never deleted). Existing order lines keep their snapshot price. `imageKey`: omitted keeps the photo, null removes it, a `tmp/…` key replaces it, the current key keeps it, anything else → 400.

patch.description: Permission: menu:write. Access token from the access_token cookie, or Authorization: Bearer. `options` is the new active set: listed ids are updated and re-activated, new ones added, missing ones switched off (`isAvailable: false`, never deleted). Switched-off options can no longer be ordered; existing order lines keep their name and price. An option id of another group → 400. Last write wins (no stale check).
